name: Stability AI
tagline: Open-weight generative models for image, video, audio, and 3D.
description: Stability AI is the company behind Stable Diffusion and a family of open and proprietary generative models spanning image (Stable Diffusion, Stable Image), video (Stable Video), audio (Stable Audio), and 3D. Its models can be self-hosted under Stability's licensing, called through the Platform API, or used in the DreamStudio web app, giving builders an open alternative to closed image-generation endpoints.
insight: Bankrolled and released Stable Diffusion in August 2022 — the open-weight model that brought AI image generation to consumer GPUs.

modelSupport.notes: Stability's own open-weight and proprietary generative models.

edge: Self-host the weights or call the same models via API across image, video, audio, and 3D — not a single locked proprietary endpoint.
cons: Quality trails closed leaders on some tasks
Community licenses aren't OSI open source
